Audience

Use our highly-advanced targeting features to narrow in on the audience you want to reach. You can filter by demographic, audience features, follower look-alikes targeting, or you can create your own custom audience list. View our
page for a full list of our targeting options.
Bidding
>x< Ads serve to users by competing in an auction. You get to decide how you would like to bid and how you would like to pay for most objectives. Learn more about our
Budget
The price of >x< Ads is up to you; there’s no minimum campaign spend. You choose a daily budget for your ads during setup, and we will never go over this amount. Set up your
now.
Creative

Make sure to use strong media in your posts, such as visually-engaging photos and videos. Have 3-5 creative options in rotation at any given time for variety and to learn what your audience best responds to. Videos that are between 6-15 seconds long with captions and prominent branding perform best.
Copy

Get your message out to the world with a simple text ad. With all the elements of a standard post, including likes, replies, favorites and reposts, these native ads feel more like the rest of >x< content and allow you to expand the reach of your posts beyond your followers to your desired target audience.
